visible_difference: Under the proposal, a viewer would still see the same side view of one car set in one brown sheet while a following camera drifts with it. The plan adds more streaks, a stronger tilt, a somewhat larger car and a rising waterline. It is the same staging with stronger settings, not a different visible action. The s3 creek has now failed in panel round 1 (12.4 to 14.8 s, 'creek car tiny and nearly static'), in the continuous-water round 7 batch and in phone round 18 (12.4 to 17.2 s, 'flat calm sheet, level car, slow drift'). The panel round 1 one_sentence_fix already asked for 'a larger card and creek car with a visible sweep from 12.6s', and the round 18 cut is that repair. Repeating 'larger car, stronger sideways drift and tilt' renames the same knobs. A real replacement would change what the car does relative to fixed things. Lock the camera on a fixed limestone ledge and a bank live oak. Start the car at the low crossing or the shallow bank edge. Let the current visibly push it off that edge and carry it across a large share of the frame, past the fixed landmarks, within n3, with a bow wave on its upstream side and the waterline climbing the doors. Alternatively, cut to the existing overhead creek-plan, where the car's travel along a fixed channel past fixed oaks reads as displacement. For s8, a separately staged low close is acceptable only if it is a new composition with new content. It needs the tag clipping onto the cord in the foreground and the nearest roof pod and its check filling a large share of the frame, with a cut inside 4 s. A changed camera position on the same lot drawing would be the relabel round 18 already rejected.
